extended:
**Generalized Markov traces and Jucys-Murphy elements**

*Kostiantyn Tolmachov, Heorhii Zhylinskyi*

12 pp, 13 sections.

**Abstract.** We give a simple construction of Markov traces for Iwahori-Hecke algebras associated with infinite series of crystallographic Coxeter groups. In types B and D it is new, and generalizes a known construction in type A employing symmetric polynomials in multiplicative Jucys-Murphy elements.

**Outline.** Front matter; Introduction.; Acknowledgments.; Iwahori-Hecke algebras and multiplicative Jucy; Coxeter groups.; Iwahori-Hecke algebras.; Trace functional and a pairing on H(W,S).; ``Full twist'' and Jucys-Murphy elements.; Some central elements in the classical Iwahori; Markov traces.; Markov traces via Jucys-Murphy elements.; General Markov traces in types B, D.; Geometric Markov traces.
